newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris leads Dec 96 EU air cargo growth rate table.
newsitem.headline: Paris leads Dec 96 EU air cargo growth rate table.

text.p: The Paris airports recorded the highest percentage gain in cargo traffic last month among the EU's top cargo-handling airports, according to figures issued by the Aeroports de Paris (ADP).
December 1996 cargo traffic handled at Charles de Gaulle and Orly airports totalled 99,100 tonnes, up 8.8 percent on the same month in 1995.
Amsterdam's Schiphol airport handled 99,500 tonnes or an increase of 7.2 percent on the same month the previous year.

December 1996 volume at Frankfurt airport was up 4.4 percent on 1995 levels at 117,300 tonnes while cargo throughput at the three London airports (Heathrow, Gatwick and Stansted), totalled 121,500 tonnes, a rise of 1.6 percent.
Of the EU's top four cargo-handling airports, Amsterdam recorded the highest percentage gain in cargo traffic in 1996 with volume rising by 10.8 percent to 1,083,000 tonnes, provisional figures show.
Traffic handled at the London airports last year totalled 1,437,000 tonnes, up five percent on 1995 levels.
Frankfurt airport's cargo throughput in 1996 amounted to 1,338,000 tonnes, up 3.3 percent on the same period last year.
Cargo traffic handled at the Paris airports increased by 1.1 percent reaching 1,112,500 tonnes in 1996.
